item.title: Amazon blocks 1,800 North Koreans from applying for jobs
item.description: US tech giant Amazon said it has blocked over 1,800 North Koreans from joining the company, as Pyongyang sends large numbers of IT workers overseas to earn and launder funds. item.title: IndiGo launches daily direct Rewa-Indore flights
item.description: IndiGo has, commenced daily, direct flights between Rewa and Indore. Rewa is the airline’s sixth destination in Madhya Pradesh after Bhopal, Gwalior, Indore, Jabalpur, and Khajuraho. This new service will open air travel for many first-time fliers across the Vindhya region. item.title: Ahmedabad’s Smart City claims contrast with 4.57 lakh sewer overflow complaints in a year
item.description: Ahmedabad’s liveable city claims have come under scrutiny as citizens continue to struggle with basic civic amenities. Data reveals that in just 11 months, residents filed 8,10,561 online complaints related to essential services provided by the Amdavad Municipal Corporation (AMC). Of these, complaints linked to sewer overflows, contaminated water supply, and road works under the engineering department alone stood at 4,57,097, accounting for nearly 50% of the total grievances. item.title: Kiran Ankush Jadhav wins Gold in 10m Air Rifle at National Shooting Championship
item.description: Navy’s Kiran Ankush Jadhav produced a consistent performance to clinch the gold medal in the 10 metre Air Rifle Men final in the 68th National Shooting Championship in Bhopal at the MP State Shooting Academy today. Jadhav finished with 252.1, holding off Olympian Arjun Babuta, who secured a silver medal with 251.4, while reigning 50m Rifle 3 Positions national champion Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar completed the podium with 229.8.
